Stop driving now. If you see smoke or flames coming from under the hood, pull over immediately, shut the engine off, and get everyone out and well away from the car. Don't open the hood — opening it feeds air to a fire. Call 911 if there are flames.

A burning-oil smell from the engine bay can escalate quickly, and it's not safe to keep driving to a shop. Get the car to a safe place and have it towed from there if you can't pull over right now.

Once the car is somewhere safe, a Diagnostic Scan will get a mechanic eyes on it to confirm what's actually going on — could be a simple leak, could be something worse. Want me to set that up?
